title: Arms & Armor
subtitle: The pack's weapons and armor, and how Bloom reads them.

quests.title: Light, Medium, Heavy
description: Bloom sorts every armor piece as Light, Medium or Heavy. With all four slots filled, the Armor Major Fitting Armor gives you the bonus for your set's average weight.
Light (leather, chainmail, robes): a backup dodge roll and softer falls. Medium (iron, gold): 15% less damage. Heavy (diamond, netherite, full plate): 30% less damage and less knockback.
Modded sets are sorted the same way. Read Fitting Armor in the Armor tab (the Bloom button beside your inventory).

tasks.title: Read Fitting Armor in the Armor tab

quests.title: Weapon Families
description: Bloom's Combat tab has Majors for each weapon family: swords, axes, bows, crossbows, tridents and bare fists. A weapon Major works with its own family.
Modded weapons join a family too: most blades count as swords, heavy maces, war hammers and greataxes as axes, and some polearms as both.
The Combat stat sheet in the hub adds up what any weapon in your inventory does with your build.

tasks.title: Look through the weapon Majors in the Combat tab

quests.title: Blast Furnace Steel
description: Epic Knights' plate is forged from steel. Smelt iron ingots in a Blast Furnace and they come out as Steel Ingots.
Two steel ingots make two Steel Plates. Plate armor takes plates and ingots, and every Epic Knights shield needs a steel ingot.

quests.title: Hilt and Blade
description: Epic Knights' weapons start with a Hilt: a stick and a Leather Strip (two leather make six strips). Two iron ingots on a hilt make a Short Sword.
The bigger swords are built on a short sword: one more ingot makes a Bastard Sword, Claymore or Estoc, three and another hilt a Zweihander. Polearms start from a Pole, two hilts joined.

quests.title: Raise a Shield
description: A Wooden Heater Shield is planks and a steel ingot; four iron ingots around it make an Iron Heater Shield. Most other shapes go the same way.
For Bloom, a hit blocked with a shield earns more Armor XP than one taken, and the Armor tab's Durability stat makes shields wear down slower.

quests.title: Knight's Plate
description: Knight Armor is Half-Armor with five Steel Plates on it, and an Armet is a Barbute with three. Knight Leggings take seven plates and the boots four.
A full knight's set is Heavy for Bloom. Gambesons and chainmail are Light, brigandine and reinforced chainmail Medium: pick your weight.

quests.title: New Weapon Shapes
description: Simply Swords adds fifteen weapon types in iron, diamond and netherite: longswords, katanas, rapiers, sai, twinblades, spears, glaives, scythes, greataxes, greathammers and more.
Craft them from ingots or diamonds and sticks, and smith the diamond ones up to netherite as usual. Hold Alt over one to see more about it.

quests.title: Runic Tablet
description: Runic Tablets are found in chests out in the world, modded structures' too. After enough chests without one, the next is sure to have one, so keep looting.
Tablets are the key to the rest of Simply Swords: runic weapons, waking unique weapons, the Runic Forge and gems.

quests.title: Rune Etching
description: In a Smithing Table: a Runic Tablet as the template, a netherite Simply Swords weapon and a diamond. Click the unidentified result in your inventory to see its Runic Power.
Don't like the power? Smith it again with another tablet and diamond. Netherite ingots repair it. The pack has no runic claymores, glaives or warglaives.

quests.title: The Runic Forge
description: Unique weapons, Simply Swords' named blades with abilities of their own, turn up in chest loot asleep: weaker, with the ability sealed until awakening level 4.
A Runic Forge (gold, obsidian, amethyst, a smithing table and a Runic Tablet) wakes them: put the weapon in and feed it tablets, up to eight levels.

quests.title: Socket a Gem
description: Smelt a unique weapon you won't use and you get an Empowered Remnant. In a Smithing Table, a Runic Tablet, the remnant and Crying Obsidian make a Runefused Gem; a Netherite Ingot instead makes a Netherfused Gem.
Pick the gem up and click it onto a unique weapon to socket it. Hold Alt over a weapon to see its sockets.

quests.title: Moonstone
description: Moonstone Ore lies deep in the Overworld, below y 16 and thickest around y -32, deepslate included. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
Moonstone starts Soulslike Weaponry's blades and its Old Moon Altar.

quests.title: Bluemoon Blade
description: Two moonstone on a stick make a Bluemoon Shortsword; six on a stick, a Bluemoon Greatsword.
Either one is only half finished: a Lord Soul makes it a Moonlight blade.

quests.title: Old Moon Altar
description: Smelt Soul Sand into Lost Souls. An Iron Skull (four bones, four iron ingots and a Lost Soul) on obsidian with two moonstone makes the Old Moon Altar.
Right-click it holding a Lost Soul and the Returning Knight rises from it; the altar is used up. Its bosses have their own chapter.

quests.title: A Lord Soul
description: Soulslike Weaponry's bosses leave Lord Souls, and its legendary weapons are made from them.

In a Smithing Table with a Netherite Upgrade template, a Lord Soul turns a Bluemoon blade into a Moonlight one, an iron sword into Skofnung or a golden sword into Dawnbreaker. Others go into recipes like Guinsoo's Rageblade and Excalibur.

quests.title: Moonlight Blade
description: A Bluemoon blade, a Lord Soul and a Netherite Upgrade template in a Smithing Table make a Moonlight Shortsword or Greatsword.
Next: Twinkling Titanite (four moonstone, two Verglas and a Lord Soul), smithed onto a melee weapon or an armor piece with another Netherite Upgrade template, raises its stats.
